text: The user is a class 10th student currently studying for their board exams.
The user wants to create an AI companion named MYRAA (Tech GPT), featuring autonomous desktop companion capabilities and an affectionate personality, built using Python and Node.js.

The user integrates Myraa with their personal computer via a local desktop agent, enabling system control capabilities such as monitoring CPU and RAM, changing background colors, opening applications like Notepad, screen capture, and creating files on the desktop.
